UC-985.en: When the lawyer asks for no tracked changes, a clean edit or no markup, use `stetdoc edit --no-track` and say it is not tracked, so Word has nothing to accept or reject, and the earlier version is in Versions. Use `--manual` only when the lawyer asks for manual markup by name.
UC-985.by: app track (provisional; Rohan's 23 Nov ruling on clean edits, via the orchestrator)
UC-985.note: Model-facing: both agents' instructions on every OS (crates/profile/assets/instructions/tools.txt). English alone: the agent answers in the lawyer's language.
